texto: To link an opinion to a reason, use **çünkü** («because») or **-dığı için** («because / since»).
**rağmen** means «despite the»: **yoğun çalışmama rağmen** = even though I work hard.
You can organize ideas with **hem ... hem de ...** («As... as well as...»).

frases.tr: Şehirde yaşamayı seviyorum çünkü her yere kolayca gidiyorum.
frases.es: Me gusta vivir en la ciudad porque puedo ir fácilmente a todas partes.
frases.en: I like living in the city because I can easily go everywhere.

frases.tr: Ben doğada vakit geçirmeyi tercih ediyorum.
frases.es: Yo prefiero pasar tiempo en la naturaleza.
frases.en: I'd rather spend time in nature.

frases.tr: Yoğun çalışmama rağmen akşamları arkadaşlarımla buluşuyorum.
frases.es: A pesar de trabajar mucho, por las tardes quedo con mis amigos.
frases.en: Despite working a lot, I'm staying with my friends in the afternoon.

frases.tr: Hem ailemle hem de arkadaşlarımla vakit geçirmek benim için önemli.
frases.es: Para mí es importante pasar tiempo tanto con mi familia como con mis amigos.
frases.en: It's important to me to spend time with both my family and my friends.

opciones.explicacion: It points to a difficulty that does not prevent the other action.
Hem way a couple with hem.
He doesn't say that's his preference.

opciones.texto: with my family and my friends.
opciones.explicacion: The structure is... hem in sum two elements.

opciones.texto: first with the family and then with friends
opciones.explicacion: It doesn't mark a temporary order.

bloques.pregunta: What does Anna do despite working a lot?

opciones.texto: He's with his friends in the afternoon.
He stays in the office all night.

bloques.frase: Hem ailemle hem de arkadaşlarımla vakit geçirmek önemli.

opciones.texto: It's important to spend time with both my family and my friends.
opciones.explicacion: Hem... hem of presents two elements.

opciones.texto: It's important to work with my friends.
I'd rather live in the city.

bloques.pregunta: Complete: «Although I work hard, I stay in the afternoon.».

opciones.texto: I'd rather spend time in nature.
opciones.explicacion: Doğada = in nature; velth ediyorum = I prefer.

opciones.texto: I'd rather work in the city.
I like spending time with my family.

bloques.frase: Hem ailemle hem de arkadaşlarımla vakit geçiriyorum
bloques.traduccion: I spend time with both my family and my friends.

intro: Explain how your way of life is and justify your preferences with examples.
